2609.10248.title: A-JIT: Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction
2609.10248.paper_summary: Traditional software delivery assumes a static paradigm: code is constructed prior to execution and deployed as a fixed artifact. We present Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction (A-JIT), a paradigm that replaces static binaries with dynamic, software systems that can perpetually evolve to meet changing demands. In A-JIT, an application is an integrated assembly comprising code, a runtime harness, and an embedded AI agent that continuously observes system usage and live execution traces. Much like a traditional JIT compiler specializes machine code to runtime execution paths, A-JIT specializes software logic, workflows, and tool interfaces to meet the specific needs of the end-user. By integrating synthesis directly into the ambient application lifecycle, A-JIT enables applications to dynamically construct missing implementations, generate new capabilities on the fly, and continuously adapt to end-user behavior. We demonstrate how this model supports trace-driven human-AI co-construction and opens a new design space for adaptive, self-evolving software.
2609.10248.paper_summary_zh: 傳統軟體交付假設了一個靜態範式：代碼在執行之前構建並作為固定的工件部署。我們提出了代理即時軟體建構（A-JIT），這是一種用動態軟體系統取代靜態二進位檔的範式，這些系統可以不斷演變以滿足不斷變化的需求。在 A-JIT 中，應用程式是一個集成的組合，包含代碼、運行時環境和一個嵌入式 AI 代理，該代理持續觀察系統使用情況和實時執行痕跡。就像傳統的 JIT 編譯器專門針對運行時執行路徑優化機器碼一樣，A-JIT 專門針對軟體邏輯、工作流程和工具介面，以滿足最終使用者的特定需求。通過將合成直接整合到周圍的應用程式生命週期中，A-JIT 使應用程式能夠動態構建缺失的實作、即時生成新功能，並持續適應最終使用者的行為。我們展示了這一模型如何支持基於追蹤的人工智慧與人類共同建構，並為自適應、自我演變的軟體開啟了一個新的設計空間。
2609.10248.author: Mark Marron et.al.
